answer: Because the whisper burn is logged at the nebula settlement, the ember audit exposes the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 95% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. A 63 account operation therefore ties up 40 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
